instrument: Goldwater Institute position that the Pima County data center moratorium is unlawful
summary: The Goldwater Institute says Pima County's 120-day data center moratorium violates two state laws, including a voter-approved initiative, because the county cannot show data centers are an imminent threat. No lawsuit is reported as filed.
notes: The moratorium passed 3-2 on Sept 22, 2026 and runs 120 days to January. It applies to new data centers where site improvement permits have not been submitted; Project Blue is already under construction, and the effect on Project Gravel is disputed because its land is zoned industrial (AZPM).
confidence_note: A position, not a filing. The statutes cited are not named in the source seen.
